en:
Paragraph 1, first sentence based upon Art. 45, Pacific Settlement Convention, 1899; Art. 70, idem, 1907; second sentence, cf. Art. 23, Paragraph 2, 1907, Pacific Settlement Convention.

Paragraph 2, practically identical with Art. 46, Pacific Settlement Convention, 1899; Art. 71, idem, 1907.
fr:
Par. 1, 1ère phrase basée sur Art. 45, Convention sur le Règlement Pacifique, 1899; Art. 70, idem, 1907; 2nde phrase, cf. Art. 23, Par. 2, 1907, Convention sur le Règlement Pacifique.

Par. 2, pratiquement identique à Art. 46, Convention sur le Règlement Pacifique, 1899; Art. 71, idem, 1907.
